culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Monpei Kogure. He wanted to avenge Yoshikuwa. After the case is closed, Detective Takagi tells Conan that previous case suspect Benzaki said that he does not remember being involved in the pickpocket case. He is also single. Conan, who now suspects that the fake couple was Bourbon and Vermouth, rushes back to the Mouri Detective Agency in panic, worried that Haibara has been compromised.

summary.en: Kogoro is undercover at the Blue Parrot, because Yuzuki Fukui asked him to investigate on a weird sound she hears frequently. Conan joins him, saying that Ran is angry because Kogoro is not home. But a simple investigation in a bar becomes more dramatic when Chikafumi Usuda, an office worker, is found dead.

suspects: Mika Kishiura, Kensaku Hatsumura, and Monpei Kogure
suspectsZh: 岸浦美香、初村谦作与小暮门平
